title: UAP near plants ages them 10 years

tellings.quote: A UAP was hovering near some plants, and as an individual approached the UAP, the UAP shot off as many people have experienced. However, when the plants that were close to the UAP were analyzed, they had aged 10 years

There was a study, I believe, in the '70s, which basically showed that there was an observation in which a UAP was hovering near some plants. And as an individual approached the UAP, the UAP shot off, as many people have experienced. However, when the plants that were close to the UAP were analyzed, they had aged 10 years within X amount of hours.
tellings.difference: Places it in a 1970s study and says the ageing happened within some number of hours.
tellings.link_reason: The same account by Rossi of plants near a hovering UAP that were found to have aged ten years.

as_told.title: 1970s study: plants near UAP aged ten years

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast about a case he heard of, which he places in a 1970s study. According to him, a UAP, a UFO, was hovering near some plants and shot off when a person came close, and when the plants were tested they had aged ten years, he says within a matter of hours. He tells it as a sign that these objects may bend time itself.
